source: Onkelos on Exod 31:2-6; the pairing at Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 13
claim_en: Bezalel EXALTED BY NAME, filled with spirit from before the LORD in wisdom, understanding, and knowledge — and TO TEACH craftsmanship: the master is a teacher (Onkelos Exod 31); Oholiab of Dan beside him — the greatest tribe paired with the lowliest, as the Temple would pair Solomon with Hiram: no commission breeds rank (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 13).

Bezalel's name announced from Adam's days — the generations pre-called, the whole builder-chain shown to the first man (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 12): the by-name office-grant carries a pre-registration doctrine. Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Onkelos on Exod 31:13-17; the labor row at Mishnah Shabbat 7:1
claim_en: BUT My Sabbaths you shall keep — the scoping particle the tradition reads as the labors' own boundary: the tabernacle work does not override the Sabbath, and from this join the case shelf's labor catalog hangs (Mishnah Shabbat 7:1, this exam's docket). The double sanction — death for the profaner, karet for the worker; an everlasting covenant; He CEASED AND RESTED; the Memra the covenant party twice (Onkelos Exod 31).

source: Onkelos on Exod 31:18; the gift-reading at Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 16
claim_en: The tablets of TESTIMONY, stone, written with the FINGER of God — the anthropomorphism survives translation: divine authorship is load-bearing ink (Onkelos Exod 31). The spine's dossier rides: learned-and-forgotten forty days then GIVEN AS GIFT; PRINCIPLES taught, not the whole; Written by day, ORAL by night — the two-channel curriculum on the mountain; stone because most penalties stone; the engraving read as FREEDOM, the recorded three-way dispute (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 16).

The GREAT PRINCIPLE: forgot the Sabbath's very principle — one offering for everything; knew it but forgot the days — one per Sabbath; knew the day but forgot the labors — one per labor-category; many of one kind — one (Mishnah Shabbat 7:1). The aggregation algebra hung from the juxtaposition EX31-03 seats. Seated from the Step 9 Ki Tisa exam, auto-seat law.
